answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared vault before it can trade, with identity tied to a single onyx keypair that accumulates reputation over time. A summit of established peers only admits accounts whose stake has aged through several epochs, so a newcomer cannot instantly flood the market. An attacker creating thousands of fake identities must fund and lock a separate stake for each, and lose it if peers detect duplicate behaviour, making a Sybil flood expensive while honest agents pay only a temporary lockup.
